rca: The receipt read pg_xact_commit_timestamp on a separate connection, but projected that database clock through a host/collector clock envelope. The observed database-versus-host offset made a valid causal commit appear after host response completion. Strict V4 requires an independent nonce-bound database clock anchor before this timestamp can be compared across domains.
remediation: Bracket a separate-connection database clock_timestamp observation with host monotonic samples, bind its nonce/source/backend identity into the receipt, and project commit timestamps only through that independently measured database envelope. Keep commit ACK and durable readback as the causal proof and fail closed on envelope ambiguity.
